subject.title: bug: publish-plugin page cannot upload plugin folders; auto-changelog overwrites edits; package changelog uses wrong history

question: Should the current plugin release publish flow add package-history auto changelog previews, or should package changelogs remain manual-only?
rationale: Current main no longer has package preview wiring, and the remaining fix changes the visible publish UX plus a public Convex package action.

options.title: Review and land package previews
options.body: Resolve proof and review requirements on https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2947, then close this issue when the PR merges.

options.title: Keep package changelogs manual
options.body: Close this as intentionally manual-only after documenting or confirming that package changelog auto-preview is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Review and land package previews
recommendation.body: Resolve proof and review requirements on https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2947, then close this issue when the PR merges.
